text: This is a B1 text about sports. In modern society, sports plays a surprisingly significant role. Although some people might dismiss it as trivial, the impact of sports on our daily lives is undeniable. For instance, when we consider how much time and resources are devoted to sports, it becomes clear that it shapes our cultural landscape. Personally, I have found that engaging with sports has broadened my horizons and allowed me to connect with diverse groups of people.
